summary: Host Digital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a registration rights agreement on October 1, 2026 with certain holders covering resale of up to 342,864 Class A common shares issued as restricted stock, and compensatory grants to employees including CFO John Ollet under the May 27, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger among the Company, Healthy Choice Wellness II Corp. and Host Digital Infrastructure LLC. A shelf registration statement under Rule 415 must be filed within 30 days of September 17, 2026, with commercially reasonable efforts to keep it effective. No price, premium or deal economics are stated; watch resale overhang and any related merger completion.
